title: Introduction to Kenyan Sign Language and Total Communication: Main Exam, 30 August 2019

unitTitle: Introduction to Kenyan Sign Language and Total Communication
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Describe the following approaches as used in the education of learners with hearing challenges.
Differentiate between sign language and a language.
Discuss total communication as used in the education of the deaf.
State the two basic models in bilingual education.
Identify the three approaches in oralism.
Explain what expressive skills in sign language are.
State the two types of manual alphabets used in the world today.
Identify three skills included in pre-manual skills. j) State the correct handshape when making the following signs. i) SORRY

items.text: Explain rules that one should observe during speech reading.
Explain and give the importance of etiquette in sign language.
With the aid of examples, discuss the elements of a sign.
Discuss four features used in making plural and singular in Kenyan Sign Language.
